description.value:
You fire up to three bolts of energy at creatures you choose within 60 feet, no two of which may be more than 10 feet apart. If you target three creatures, each must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 energy damage. Targeting two creatures instead, each takes 1d6 energy damage on a failure; targeting only one, it takes 1d8 energy damage on a failure.

This power's damage increases by one die at 5th level (two dice), 11th level (three dice), and 17th level (four dice).
